title: Trimo Cladding
activity: Trimo panel cladding: pre-start, support, base channels, panels, flashings
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

questions.q: Outlets installed and open (by others), area clear?
Minimum upstands achievable: 75 mm at doors and windows, 150 mm elsewhere?
Quality benchmark agreed for the first area?
Ask the fitter: What upstand height is achieved at doors and edges? Could they answer?
questions.source: SuperPrime site practice – a fitter who can't answer is a red flag

questions.q: Backing support set out and level, fixed at the LPL drawing centres?
questions.source: LDP Trimo ITP 00004 checklist – backing support; ITP 2.1

questions.q: Nested base channels fixed, EPDM bonded to the waterproofing, channel void insulated?
questions.source: LDP Trimo ITP 00004 checklist – nested base channels

questions.q: Head detail: back-to-back angles and fixings to the slab edge per the LPL drawing?
questions.source: LDP Trimo ITP 00004 checklist – head detail

questions.q: Panels at the drawing location, level, fixed at the LPL centres, washers not crushed?
questions.source: LDP Trimo ITP 00004 checklist – panel installation

questions.q: Void between panels and support fully insulated; mineral wool at internal corners and head?
Corners fixed per the corner fixing detail?
Panels undamaged, consistent colour, wiped down?
Closure flashings match the LPL detail at each location, lapped and sealed?
questions.source: LDP Trimo ITP 00004 checklist – flashings; ITP 2.3

questions.q: Downpipes, hoppers and RWPs fitted and clear?

notOk.t: Interface to smoke duct not waterproofed
Sealant spilled on panels; panels dirty
600 mm maintenance clearance to services not kept

ask.q: What upstands are needed at doors and windows?
ask.a: 75 mm at doors and windows, 150 mm elsewhere.

ask.q: How are the panel joints sealed?
ask.a: As the Trimo detail – sealant/tapes continuous.
As the Trimo fixing drawing – every fixing in.
